title: Optic Neuropathy in 10 Patients With Glioblastoma Receiving Bevacizumab
brief_summary: Does treatment with bevacizumab (Avastin) in combination with prior or current radiotherapy lead to optic neuropathy?
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed w Glioblastoma grade IV, and scheduled to begin chemo radiotherapy with Avastin

Exclusion Criteria:

* No diagnosis of GBM, not scheduled to begin treatment with avastin in combination with radiotherapy.
